title: Machines that care
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a robotok és a mesterséges intelligencia szerepéről az ápolásban és a gyógyításban.

scenes.description: In a care home, an elderly woman in a wheelchair is talking to a small white robot with a screen for a face. The robot is showing her photos of her grandchildren and reminding her to take her medicine. In the background, a nurse is hurrying past with a tray, clearly very busy. The woman is smiling at the robot as if it were an old friend.

In a hospital operating theatre, a surgeon is sitting at a control console, guiding the arms of a surgical robot that is operating on a patient. Two other doctors and a nurse are watching the screens closely. Everything is bright, clean and quiet, and the atmosphere is extremely focused.

prompts: Compare the roles that robots play in the two pictures.
In which areas of life can robots and AI be most helpful?
What are the risks of relying too much on machines, especially when caring for people?
followUpQuestions: Would you trust a robot to look after your grandparents? Why or why not?
Which jobs should always be done by humans?
Who should be responsible if a robot or an AI system makes a mistake?
How might artificial intelligence change medicine in the next twenty years?
